designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1991 to protect cave habitat for the threatened Ozark cavefish; managed from Mingo National Wildlife Refuge.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Ozark Cavefish National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, June 4, 2007 (E7-10676): CCP notice for Mingo, Pilot Knob and Ozark Cavefish NWRs, "Ozark Cavefish NWR was established in 1991"
FWS story, Sept. 2026: refuge protecting cave habitat "since the October 22, 1991"

review.note: Year confirmed. An FWS story gives Oct. 22, 1991, but only FWS sources give the day, so the date stays at the year. Establishing authority not found.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Ozark Cavefish National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1991 and is managed by the staff at Mingo National Wildlife Refuge.
